message: The other day, I overheard my grandkids talking about how I always stock up on snacks before a storm. They rolled their eyes and said, "Nana, it’s not like we’re going to get snowed in for weeks!" Well, when that unexpected winter storm hit, and we were cozy inside with our hot cocoa and a mountain of popcorn, I couldn’t help but enjoy my little smug 'I told you so' moment. Sometimes, a little preparation just means a lot more snacks and a lot more smiles. 🍿
